title: Starbucks Strawberry Acai Lemonade (Easy Copycat Recipe)
description: A simple and delicious copycat recipe for the viral Starbucks Strawberry Acai Lemonade, with an option to turn it into the famous "Pink Drink." This recipe shows how to create a homemade "Refresher Base" that's shockingly close to the original.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 1/2 cup chilled green tea (optional, for caffeine)
1/2 cup chilled green tea (optional, for caffeine)
instructions:
1. Create the base by blending white grape juice, strawberries, and acai powder until smooth. Stir in chilled green tea if using.
  2. To make one drink, fill a shaker with ice and freeze-dried strawberries.
  3. Add 1/2 cup of the base and 1/2 cup of lemonade.
  4. Shake vigorously for 15 seconds.
  5. Pour into a glass and serve.
notes:
• Don't Skip the Shake: Shaking is crucial! It perfectly chills, mixes, and aerates the drink, giving it a light, frothy texture.
  • Batch Your Base: Make a larger batch of the base at the start of the week for incredibly fast drink-making later.
  • The Power of Freeze-Dried Fruit: Using freeze-dried strawberries isn't just for looks. They rehydrate in the drink, releasing extra pockets of strawberry flavor as you sip.
